scope: Two local UI blocks: HP plaque; profile framing, identity and navigation. No replacement actor, equipment, portrait bitmap or world material.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D fantasy RPG UI sprite atlas, NOT a screenshot, NO LETTERING. Create a precisely aligned 2 by 2 atlas on a truly transparent canvas, four equal cells. Each component centered within its cell, with at least 6% transparent padding. Fine hand-painted gold filigree, strong readable large forms, deep shadows and warm highlights, parchment, burgundy leather, like a premium illuminated medieval character sheet. Top-left: a wide horizontal health plaque, aspect ratio 3.4:1, thick sculpted bevelled gold border, elegant chamfered corners, tiny restrained leaf flourishes. Interior dark oxblood red leather, softly lit richer ruby center and near-black shaded edges. Completely EMPTY inside: no heart, no text, no bar. Top-right: a wide horizontal name cartouche, aspect ratio 3.4:1, warm ivory parchment with a sculpted polished golden frame and restrained curled leaf corners, generously empty light writing area. Bottom-left: a wide horizontal tab/button, aspect ratio 3.4:1, very dark walnut/brown leather inset, polished gold bevel border, simple chamfered corners, modest tiny flourishes. Empty, no icon or text. Bottom-right: ONE large symmetrical convex GOLD HEART emblem, a simple plump heart silhouette with a golden raised rim, warm amber shadow and bright cream-gold highlight; smooth clean gold interior, no filigree inside, no wings or gems. All four objects orthographic front view, crisp painterly detail, absolutely no letters/numbers, no background sheet, no labels, no extra items. Matching coherent gold materials. Transparent background.
